authorization.visibility: Only after the user creates an existing Goal with /goal; no Goal means no edit tool or Goal bar.
authorization.ai_capability: edit_goal_objective replaces only existing objective text; no lifecycle, session, Goal identity, budget or verification arguments.
authorization.existing_completion_policy: Persisted AgentReport/UserConfirm policy unchanged; no new lifecycle management action exposed.

changes: Full selectable Goal details and 840px multiline editor; two-line compact preview.
User draft conflicts preserve text when AI or another source changes the objective.
Session-bound definition/activation/control fence; round accounting revisions tolerated.
Atomic objective/definition update and obsolete Goal-input removal; ordinary user work retained.
Old definition reports cannot accept revised objectives; cancellation/failure protections and current lifecycle remain intact.

validation.rust_remote_host: WZU_Server (same V100 host; existing rescue/raw Tailscale routes recovered without disabling host-key verification)
validation.source_verification: 587 Rust sources/manifests including uncommitted edits matched SHA-256 before final compilation.
validation.browsers: Chromium and WebKit source fixtures; 320/375/960px, light/dark, locales, multiline editing, conflict and lifecycle regressions passed
validation.architecture: dependency/freeze checks, 10 managed-boundary mutation tests and 20 freeze regression tests passed

limitations: No hosted CI or Windows/native desktop acceptance claimed.
No live user Goal/session mutation, local Rust compilation, release, installation, restart, worktree deletion or agent interruption.

Initial test fixture used a current ref instead of next tombstone revision for clear; corrected the fixture, not the durable validator. Initial failures and transient-network/source-mismatch logs retained outside the repository.
New v2 edit_objective operation is additive for the current reader; downgrade to an older binary is not guaranteed.
